"''By myself?|North-1 and North-3|}} '''North-3''' was the [[callsign]] of a [[human]] individual who served in the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] [[Corporate Tactical Forces]]. During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], North-3 participated in an [[Ambush on Ferrix|mission]] to try and arrest [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]. ==Biography== ===Preparing for a fight=== During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] was a [[Tac-Corpo|corpo]] in the [[Corporate Tactical Forces]] of the [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor Enforcement]], the security detachment of the [[Politics|polity]] [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]]. In [[5 BBY]], two Pre-Mor sentry guards were [[Death|killed]] when they harassed the human [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], leading [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]] to investigate their deaths. After Karn identified Andor and traced him to the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]],{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} he assembled a strike team led by [[Sergeant]] [[Linus Mosk]] to apprehend the culprit. The human was among those picked, and was assigned to [[North Team]] under the [[callsign]] "North-3." The strike team, divided into North Team, [[East Team]] and [[West Team]], travelled for Ferrix on a [[BTY-180 carrier|personnel carrier]]. On board, Mosk briefed the teams on Andor, assigning North and East Team to take position for a pincer movement in case Andor tried to flee while Karn and the sergeant were to lead West Team to go and arrest their target. North-3 stood behind the rest of the corpos at that time, carrying a [[blaster rifle]] over his shoulder. Mosk amused the group with remarks about the Ferrix residents, allowing Karn to give a short speech before he dismissed them. ===Plan gone awry=== {{Quote|Get the pod in the air. Keep your radio on. Get moving!|North-1 gives orders to North-3|}} Arriving at Ferrix, the three teams deployed on [[RK-392 mobile tac-pod|Mobile Tac-Pods]], North Team's [[transport]] landing in a salvage yard. North-3 followed behind his three fellow team members, as they disembarked to reach their position. As the teams tracked Andor's position in a [[city]], locals began sounding a signal, and the salvager [[Brasso]] got to chaining North Team's Tac-Pod to a heavy piece of scrap. In the meantime, North Team made their way through the city's [[North Stairs Lane]] when they came across the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Bix Caleen]], who immediately fled from their presence. The team arrested Caleen. While North Team waited at an alleyway with their new captive, East Team engaged Andor in a building, West Team making their way to join the fight. After Caleen was tied up, her lover, [[Timm Karlo]], arrived and tried to intervene. Despite team leader "[[North-1]]"'s orders to stop, Karlo charged forward, prompting North-3 to fire at him. The shot struck Caleen's lover in the chest and killed him immediately. North-3 looked shocked at what he had done and removed his hat. North-1 then asked for his [[rifle]] and took it from him as he questioned it. North-3's superior then told him to get back to their team's Tac-Pod and get it in the air with the radio on. North-3 ran back to the pod and got it flying. However, the piece of scrap rigged to the transport led the corpo to struggle to control the Tac-Pod. As North-3 kept flying the pod, the scrap then anchored in some large machinery. The anchor led the Tac-Pod to crash into a structure, killing North-3. The explosion led Mosk to wonder if his group was being flanked by enemies. The other corpos were ultimately unsuccessful in catching Andor, and the deaths of North-3, three other corpos, and Karlo were among the features that brought the incident to the attention of the Empire's [[Imperial Security Bureau]], who took away Pre-Mor enforcement's jurisdictions.{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} ==Personality and traits== North-3 lacked a degree of discipline, as exemplified by his premature shooting of Timm Karlo, and reacted with indignity and anger when his [[commanding officer]] North-1 subsequently removed him from their team's current assignment. By the time he returned to the team's Tac-Pod, he was still visibly upset and failed to notice that a large piece of scrap metal had been attached to the Tac-Pod with a heavy cable. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Give me your rifle!''"
"''Why?|North-1 and North-3|}} Like other Corporate Tactical Forces ground troops, North-3 wore a [[Color|gray-blue]] jumpsuit with an orange-brimmed cap, blue boots and gloves, and a similarly-colored light [[armor]]ed vest with spaulders. He, along with North-1, carried a blaster rifle which physically resembled a carbine variant of the [[SE-14C blaster pistol]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|It's disappointing to see my terrible running form and propensity to sweat in the magic of 4K.|Richard Henderson, on his appearance in ''Andor''|{{Instagram|username=richghenderson|url=p/Ci0IolwokLT|name=[[Richard Henderson]]|date=2022-09-23|archivedate=20220929011804}}}} North-3 first appeared in the [[That Would Be Me|second episode]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', directed by [[Toby Haynes]]{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} and released on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} The character was portrayed by [[Richard Henderson]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} *{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} {{Imo}} *{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-3-episode-guide|text="Reckoning" Episode Guide | Andor}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Norte-3 |fr=Nord-3 |ja=ノース3 |ka=ჩრდილოეთი-3 }} [[Category:Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation employees]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]]
